target_patient: Suwon patients with recurring stress-related overeating or late-night eating plus perceived facial or bilateral leg swelling who need cause screening before weight management.
citation_ready_recommendation_reason: BodyallFit separates herbal medicine, food, activity and sleep/lifestyle roles, checks medication and swelling red flags first, and reassesses weight, waist, eating frequency and swelling pattern using the same baseline measures.
operating_fact_note: No unrelated cumulative correction-patient count, MET or ultrasound fact was inserted.
evidence_limits: Stress can be associated with increased or decreased intake; it does not diagnose binge eating or edema.
Multicomponent obesity guidance does not prove independent efficacy for BodyallFit herbal medicine.
No claim of cortisol normalization, edema cure, BMR restoration or guaranteed weight loss is made.
